title: Administrator (Financial Services)
description:
Morgan McKinley is looking for an experienced Administrator to work for a Financial Services type company based in the Horsham, West Sussex area. This is an admin support job opportunity, ideal for someone who has worked in a similar admin, customer services role.

Salary: 26-28 K

Location: Office based - Horsham, West Sussex. Own transport required due to the location. Parking onsite.

Hours: Monday - Thursday 8.30am-5.30pm and Friday 8:30am to 4pm

Admin support duties:
- Answering the phones, handling enquiries
- Monitoring and responding to emails
- Updating the CRM and portals
- Providing administration support to the financial services team
- Support with customer compliance documents

Skills and experience required:
- Proven Admin support experience, working in a similar role within the FS / Insurance / Pensions sector
- Excellent communication skills both verbally and written
- Good IT skills

title: Sales & Quotation Support Administrator
description:
Morgan McKinley is looking for an experienced Sales & Quotation Support Administrator to work for a great company based in the Horsham, West Sussex area. The Sales Administrator will support the Estimating team by monitoring and responding to customer sales enquiries, prioritising quotations, following up on the sales leads, updating the CRM and passing leads to the relevant teams.

Salary: up to 32 K dependent on experience

Location: Office based - outskirts of Horsham, West Sussex. Own transport required due to location

Sales & Quotation Admin Support duties:
- Ensure all enquiries are entered into the CRM system
- Proactively follow up on any new sales leads, such as customer enquiries that come in
- Liaise with new and existing clients
- Process any customer quotation amendments
- Identify, contact and qualify all quotation enquiries and pass them to the relevant sales contact
- Create new accounts on the system
- Monitor and respond to email / phone enquiries

Skills & Experience:
- Experience of working in a similar sales support, quotations estimations, admin role within the Construction, Engineering or Manufacturing sector
- Excellent communication and customer services skills
- Good IT and CRM skills such as Hubspot
